newsitem.title: USA: ADC Telecom to buy Cirrus Logic unit.
newsitem.headline: ADC Telecom to buy Cirrus Logic unit.

text.p: ADC Telecommunications Inc said it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire a wireless infrastructure equipment group of Pacific Communication Sciences Inc for $23 million.
The company said it expected the acquisition of the group, a wholly owned subsidiary of Cirrus Logic Inc, to close in December.
It said it was also acquiring the Personal Handyphone System base station and system level design capabilities resident in the Pacific Communication.
It said the acquisitions would help it expand its presence in the wireless markets.
The company also said it was forming a business unit called Wireless Systems Group that would incorporate the acquired unit.

ADC Telecommunications Inc designs, manufactures and markets a wide variety of transmission and networking systems and broadband connectivity products for fiber optic, twisted pair, coaxial and wireless broadband global networks.
